entries.text:
I have successfully set up your Linux machine with zsh, oh-my-zsh, and miniconda as requested. Here's what was accomplished:

## Zsh and Oh-My-Zsh Setup:
✅ Installed zsh
✅ Installed oh-my-zsh 
✅ Configured the "apple" theme
✅ Installed and configured the requested plugins:
   - git (default)
   - z (for directory jumping)
   - zsh-autosuggestions (for command suggestions)
   - zsh-syntax-highlighting (for syntax highlighting)
✅ Set zsh as the default shell
✅ Configuration saved to `/root/.zshrc`

## Miniconda Setup:
✅ Downloaded and installed Miniconda3 (py39_4.12.0) 
✅ Initialized conda for both bash and zsh shells
✅ Created `terminal-bench` environment with Python 3.10
✅ Configured auto-activation of `terminal-bench` environment on login for both shells

## Cross-shell Compatibility:
✅ Conda works in both zsh and bash without extra configuration
✅ The `terminal-bench` environment activates automatically in both shells
✅ Both `/root/.zshrc` and `/root/.bashrc` are properly configured

The setup is complete and ready to use. When you start a new shell session (either zsh or bash), the `terminal-bench` conda environment will automatically activate with Python 3.10 available. The zsh session will have the apple theme and all requested plugins active.
